data.name: Sanjay
data.gender_notes: Sanjay is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'together, fully', + jaya, 'victory' — 'fully victorious'. Its root is Sanskrit saṃ + jaya. Sanjaya, the narrator of the Bhagavad Gita. Sanjay is a Sanskrit name meaning “Victorious; triumphant”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sanjay expresses “Victorious; triumphant”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit saṃ, 'together, fully', + jaya, 'victory' — 'fully victorious'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sanjay total 16, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
